checks.name: static RTL review
checks.details: Reviewed synchronous active-high reset, positive-edge sampling, byte ordering, delayed done pulse, immediate next-packet acceptance, explicit widths, nonblocking assignments, and state recovery.

checks.name: development simulation
checks.details: Compilation produced no simulation executable; vvp reported unable to open input file.

development_outcome: Initial candidate retained without RTL revisions. Independent self-checking testbench created for the supplied waveform, search gaps, consecutive packets, reset at each packet phase, and randomized byte/reset sequences, but simulation remains unverified due to compilation tool failure.
limitations: Official evaluation was not accessed and its results are unknown.
No synthesis, timing analysis, or board validation performed.
